summary: The Pay Our Military Act of 2025 ensures that members of the Armed Forces, as well as certain civilian workers and contractors who support them, continue to receive pay and allowances during any government shutdown in fiscal year 2026.

affected_groups.effect: Receive continued pay and allowances during a government shutdown if performing active service.
Receive continued pay and allowances during a shutdown if determined to be providing support to active service members.
affected_groups.group: Department of Defense and Coast Guard Civilian Personnel

affected_groups.effect: Receive continued pay and allowances during a shutdown if determined to be providing support to active service members.
affected_groups.group: Department of Defense and Coast Guard Contractors

key_provisions: Provides continuing appropriations for fiscal year 2026 military pay and allowances during any period without regular appropriations (a government shutdown).
Covers members of the Armed Forces, including reserve components, who perform active service.
Covers civilian personnel of the Department of Defense and the Coast Guard determined to be providing support to active service members.
Covers contractors of the Department of Defense and the Coast Guard determined to be providing support to active service members.
Sets a termination date for these funds when regular appropriations are enacted or on January 1, 2027, whichever comes first.
missing_information: Exact total costs or specific dollar amounts appropriated by the bill.
Specific criteria or definitions for which civilian personnel and contractors are determined to be providing support.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Pay Our Military Act of 2025 ensures that members of the Armed Forces, as well as certain civilian workers and contractors who support them, continue to receive pay and allowances during any government shutdown in fiscal year 2026.
summary_detail.significance: The bill guarantees funding for military pay and specific support personnel during a federal government shutdown, preventing payment interruptions until regular funding measures are enacted or until January 1, 2027.

title: Pay Our Military Act of 2025
